name: beaver-nest
description: Private Phoenix LiveView family app for Tailscale-based home hosting.

scripts.tailnet:up: npm exec -- nx run -p bnest-app -t tailnet:up
scripts.tailnet:status: npm exec -- nx run -p bnest-app -t tailnet:status
scripts.tailnet:down: npm exec -- nx run -p bnest-app -t tailnet:down
scripts.resource:lint: node --check tools/resource-guard/metrics.mjs && node --check tools/resource-guard/policy.mjs && node --check tools/resource-guard/evidence.mjs && node --check tools/resource-guard/session.mjs && node --check tools/resource-guard/guard.mjs && node --check tools/resource-guard/cli.mjs && node --check apps/bnest-app/tools/release.mjs && node --check apps/bnest-app/tools/resource-monitor.mjs && node --check apps/bnest-app/tools/serve.mjs && zsh -n .husky/pre-push && npm exec -- prettier --check tools/resource-guard apps/bnest-app/tools/release.mjs apps/bnest-app/tools/resource-monitor.mjs apps/bnest-app/tools/serve.mjs
scripts.resource:format: npm exec -- prettier --write tools/resource-guard apps/bnest-app/tools/release.mjs apps/bnest-app/tools/resource-monitor.mjs apps/bnest-app/tools/serve.mjs
scripts.test: node tools/resource-guard/cli.mjs run --class ephemeral -- npm exec -- nx run -p bnest-app -t test:unit
scripts.test:e2e: node tools/resource-guard/cli.mjs run --class ephemeral -- npm exec -- nx run -p bnest-app-e2e -t test:e2e

author: wahidyankf
